title: Low-temperature thermal-desorption mass spectroscopy applied to investigate the hydrogen adsorption on porous materials
material_description: SWCNTs | purified HiPco single-walled carbon nanotubes (CNI SWCNTs), closed tubes (no opening treatment), bundles
purification_method: purified by J. Vajo, HRL Laboratories (method not stated)
source_location: main p. 232 (main-3), Results, right column last paragraph; TDS spectra Figs. 4 and 5
notes: text: "total amount of desorbed hydrogen corresponds to a storage capacity of 2.6 wt% ... for SWCNTs"; Low-temperature TDS: 25 mbar H2 introduced at room temperature, sample cooled to approximately 20 K and held ~30 min, reactor evacuated to ~1e-7 mbar, then heated at 0.1 K/s; spectra recorded up to 370 K (reference_temperature_k), all H2 desorbed below 80 K. Loading temperature printed as "approximately 20 K", below the schema range of temperature_k (50-500 K), so temperature_k is left empty and temperature_unstated = true as the only valid coding (the temperature IS stated in the paper); pressure_bar = 25 mbar loading pressure (amount measured after evacuation). Quantified by calibration with PdH0.7 (Pd hydrided at 0.7 bar, RT); calibration_described = false because no free-volume or buoyancy determination applies. Home-built TDS setup described (Fig. 1, quadrupole MS, He flow cryostat). Degassing at 470 K for approximately 3 h in vacuum "better than 10^-5 mbar" (stored 0.001 Pa, an upper bound). Sample mass not stated for these runs ("usually sample masses of less than 3 mg are enough"). Paper states the TDS amount agrees "within an error of 0.2 wt%" with the 77 K isotherm maximum; this is an agreement statement, not an uncertainty of this value. Surface area 854 m2/g printed as "comparable specific surface area" / "apparent specific surface area" with no method or gas named for this sample (BET with N2 at 77 K is stated only for the activated carbon); who measured it and in which state is not stated, so area_same_sample = unclear. Produced by the HiPco method (paper); acknowledgements name "CNI SWCNTs" provided by C. Ahn (Caltech), so coded commercial.
